message.content:
Here’s a mix of classics, modern thrillers, and some hidden gems—perfect for a Friday night scare fest:

| # | Title | Year | Why It’s Worth Watching |
|---|-------|------|------------------------|
| 1 | **The Shining** (1980) | A psychological masterpiece that turns a family vacation into a nightmare. |
| 2 | **Hereditary** (2018) | A chilling descent into grief‑driven terror that feels both intimate and cosmic. |
| 3 | **Get Out** (2017) | A smart social thriller that blends horror with biting satire. |
| 4 | **A Quiet Place** (2018) | Silent tension at its finest—watch your ears! |
| 5 | **Midsommar** (2019) | Daylight dread that flips the genre on its head. |
| 6 | **It Follows** (2014) | An unsettling concept that keeps you on edge long after the credits roll. |
| 7 | **The Babadook** (2014) | Psychological horror that’s as much about motherhood as it is about monsters. |
| 8 | **The Conjuring** (2013) | Paranormal investigations that deliver genuine chills. |
| 9 | **The Witch** (2015) | Slow‑burn dread set in a bleak New England puritan world. |
|10 | **Candyman** (1992) | A haunting urban legend that still feels fresh. |

Feel free to pick one or two depending on how intense you want the night to get. Happy watching—and keep the lights on!
